Koel Benchmark Suite
	


	
		
		Dataset Description
	

The Koel Benchmark Suite is a comprehensive set of evaluation datasets designed to rigorously test the real-world performance of Text-to-Speech (TTS) models for major Indian languages. The suite focuses on challenges unique to the Indian context, such as code-switching, domain-specific terminology, proper nouns, and complex numeric formats.
